subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

_ GGHG _ _ GG _ G _
solution:
Given : _ GGHG _ _ GG _ G _

By checking options :

 
• HGHHG → __**H**__ GGHG __**G**__ __**H**__ GG __**H**__ G __**G**__ → (It follows the pattern of : HGG - HGG - HGG - HGG)
 
• GHHGH → __G__ GGHG __H__ __H__ GG __G__ G __H__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• HGGHH → __H__ GGHG __G__ __G__ GG __H__ G __H__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• HHHGH → __H__ GGHG __H__ __H__ GG __G__ G __H__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "**HGHHG**" is the correct answer.
